title: Rory and the Starry Blossom Hill
verses:
The moon was afloat on the crest of the hill,
The shadows were stretching so quiet and deep.
And Rory walked softly while breezes were still,
To guide all his friends to a meadow of sleep.

Now Benny stepped down on the moss-covered ground,
While Tilly piled petals of lavender low.
They gathered together without any sound,
Beside where the blossoms were starting to glow.

Then Ricky grew calm in the slumbering breeze,
While Nia swooped under the lantern of night.
She settled her wings in the silver-leafed trees,
And smiled at the valley of velvety light.

Then Psittaco chirped from a wide blossom bed,
And whispered good night so that Rory could hear.
And Rory leaned over to cushion his head,
While star after star in the darkness shone clear.

The valley was peaceful and quiet and wide,
As darkness was sinking away in the west.
Now Benny and Tilly lay down side by side,
And curled in the ferns for a beautiful rest.

The stars on the hillside were tender and blue,
As moonlight came down in a shimmering beam.
The petals were covered in drops of the dew,
While Rory rolled into a magical dream.
